    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCriteria" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsurerReport" name="Educational institution accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Immediate written private insurance report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured party" processRef="Process_PrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerNotification" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToAccidentInsurer" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsurerReport"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolToAccidentInsurer" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsurerReport"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee accident and safety notification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeOccurrence" name="Accident or safety concern occurs or is discovered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType" name="What was reported?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeAccident" name="Work accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeNearAccident" name="Near accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeRisk" name="Serious and immediate safety or health risk reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeDefect" name="Protection-system defect reported"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeStartNotify" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeOccurrence" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeNotifyType" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeTypeAccident" name="Work accident" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType" targetRef="End_EmployeeAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reportedType = "work accident"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeTypeNearAccident" name="Incident that almost caused an accident" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType" targetRef="End_EmployeeNearAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reportedType = "near accident"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeTypeRisk" name="Serious and immediate risk discovered" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType" targetRef="End_EmployeeRisk">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reportedType = "serious immediate risk"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeTypeDefect" name="Defect discovered in protection systems" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeOccurrenceType" targetRef="End_EmployeeDefect">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reportedType = "protection-system defect"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerNotification" name="Employee notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeNotification" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" name="Gather information about accident circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, consider whether the accident occurred at a location, time and with a cause correlated to the insured employment; while working from home; on the direct route between the permanent residence and work, lunch or home (including carpools); during training providing specific professional knowledge or on the route to or from its centre; on a direct route to a doctor and back from home, work or a training centre where that interrupts the direct route to or from work and the doctor visit was notified to the employer in advance; while travelling to or from work or a training centre to take a child to or collect a child from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; or while making use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, consider whether the accident relates by location, time and cause to insured school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year; occurred at a school or school-related event; occurred on the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school or on the way home; occurred while performing a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; or occurred in certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered circumstances can also include household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent; work providing guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling agricultural products from the farm; construction, conversion or repair of buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity can include activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labour Market Promotion Act (for example, travelling to an arranged job interview); assisting with an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of the volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsWorkAccident" name="Does the accident meet work-accident criteria?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotWorkAccident" name="No work-accident reporting duty stated"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportObligations" name="Which independent reporting obligations apply?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury to Labour Inspectorate immediately if emergency services have not reported it" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer" name="Report qualifying accident to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportObligationsJoin" name="Applicable reports completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerReportsComplete" name="Employer reporting complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoAdditionalReport" name="No additional report required under these duties"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerStartGather" sourceRef="Start_EmployerNotification" targetRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToAccidentDecision" sourceRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" targetRef="Gateway_IsWorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IsWorkAccident" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_IsWorkAccident" targetRef="Gateway_ReportObligations">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">workAccident = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorkAccident" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_IsWorkAccident" targetRef="End_NotWorkAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">workAccident = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReportRequired" name="Fatality or serious injury and emergency services have not reported it" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportObligations" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatalityOrSeriousInjury = true and reportedToEmergencyServices = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportRequired" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days, in full or in part" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportObligations" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuredPersonKilled = true or unableToWorkForThreeDays = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalReport" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportObligations" targetRef="End_NoAdditionalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReportToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportObligationsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurerReportToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_ReportObligationsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerJoinEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportObligationsJoin" targetRef="End_EmployerReportsComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReport" name="Accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolStartReport" sourceRef="Start_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurer"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsurance" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Accident occurs"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Are there fatalities?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReport" name="Private insurance reporting complete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateStartImmediate" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateImmediateGateway" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateNoFatality" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateReport"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Gather accident information and report qualifying work accidents" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" name="Gather and assess accident circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, circumstances can include an accident at a location, time and with a cause correlated to the employment; working from home; direct routes between residence, work and lunch, including carpools; professional training and travel to or from it; a doctor visit and return that interrupts a direct route when notified to the employer in advance; travel to or from work or training to take a child to or collect a child from care or school when the person has supervisory responsibility; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, relevant circumstances include a connection with insured education or the compulsory kindergarten year; school or school-related events; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; practical tasks prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered circumstances can also include household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent; guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling farm products; construction, conversion or repair of buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity can include activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labour Market Promotion Act, such as travel to an arranged job interview; assisting at an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service with the volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatality or serious injury to Labour Inspectorate immediately if not reported to emergency services" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurer" name="Report qualifying accident to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportObligationsJoin" name="Applicable reports completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerReportsComplete" name="Employer reporting complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoAdditionalReport" name="No additional report required under these reporting duties"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToWorkAccident" sourceRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" targetRef="Gateway_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IsWorkAccident" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkAccident" targetRef="Gateway_ReportObligations">

rules.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up obligations apply independently, with applicability varying by circumstance.: Model the obligations as independently activated conditional branches; if they converge, use an inclusive join so that only activated branches are awaited.
rules.situation: the description states that multiple follow-up obligations apply independently, with applicability varying by circumstance.

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple kinds of occurrences that require the same initial notification: Model one shared start event and the common notification, then use a gateway to branch by occurrence type rather than creating a separate start event for each type.
rules.situation: the description lists multiple kinds of occurrences that require the same initial notification

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or decision in terms of a specific action, object, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves that meaning; do not replace it with a broader stage name or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes decisions or activities by stated details that give them different meanings

rules.instruction: When the description makes subsequent actions depend on a stated event category or seriousness, prior notification, or an eligibility or status criterion: Model each stated distinction with a decision gateway and condition-labeled sequence flows to the applicable follow-up actions; do not represent a conditional continuation as an independent process start event.
rules.situation: the description makes subsequent actions depend on a stated event category or seriousness, prior notification, or an eligibility or status criterion

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes alternative paths by a condition that determines which outcome follows: Label the corresponding gateway with the decision condition being evaluated, rather than with a broad stage or outcome name.
rules.situation: the description specifies a decision criterion with a material qualifier that distinguishes which outcome applies
